text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While working hard to change herself, Zenno Rob Roy learns that Air Groove has high hopes for her close friend, Sweep Tosho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Sweep Tosho and I head to her grandma's house.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho explains that when people tell her what to do, she feels like they don't believe in her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing this, her grandmother offers me some advice, saying that I should consider myself more of a supporting presence than a guiding one.
